dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script_name.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes 'defusedxml' and 'vboxapi' as detected imports. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image, sets the working directory, copies and installs requirements, copies the rest of the application, and specifies the command to run the Python script. Replace 'your_script_name.py' with the actual entry point script of your application.
